note: Single source of truth for agent model assignments. Edit here only — never hardcode models elsewhere.
freshness_check: If today is more than 60 days past last_verified, ask the human to reconfirm these model IDs against current provider releases before spawning subagents, then update last_verified. The session-start hook warns when this is overdue.

orchestrator.description: Plans, decomposes, delegates, reviews diffs. Never writes production code.

implementer.codex_note: Run at Extra High intelligence in Codex settings.
implementer.description: Executes a focused spec. Runs in a worktree.

reviewer.description: Checks diff vs spec, runs quality gates.

routing.effort_note: Only xhigh needs overrides — high is the role default. xhigh escalates one tier for the rare cases AGENTS.md defines (cross-cutting bugs, security-critical work).

task_type_labels.architecture: New abstraction, cross-cutting design, ≥5 files, data model changes
task_type_labels.security_review: Auth, API key handling, RLS, rate limiting, storage access patterns
task_type_labels.ui_visual: Component or layout work, no logic change
task_type_labels.docs_config: Markdown, env vars, config files, manifest changes
task_type_labels.implementation: Default — code changes with a clear spec
